personal.preferred_title: Senior PySpark / SQL Data Engineer | Unix Shell, ETL & Financial Services

summary: Senior Data Engineer with 20+ years of enterprise technology experience across PySpark/Spark, Python, SQL, Unix/Linux shell scripting, ETL workflows, production data pipelines, scheduling/orchestration concepts, financial-services technology, data validation, and production troubleshooting. Strong background building and supporting data workflows that ingest, transform, validate, and report large operational datasets, with practical experience tracing pipeline issues from source feeds through SQL, Python/PySpark logic, shell automation, and downstream outputs. Best aligned to PySpark/SQL/Unix data engineering roles requiring hands-on Spark data processing, backend script analysis, ETL workflow support, production job troubleshooting, and finance-domain delivery.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Built Python/Pandas/PySpark ETL pipelines ingesting telemetry from 6,000+ infrastructure endpoints and transforming raw operational data into curated datasets for reporting, analytics, forecasting, validation, and decision support.
Developed PySpark and SQL-driven workflows for ingestion, cleansing, enrichment, aggregation, validation, and delivery of large operational datasets in a regulated financial-services environment.

Used Spark-style distributed processing concepts including DataFrames, transformations, actions, partition-aware design, Parquet-oriented storage patterns, and schema discipline to support scalable data processing.
Analyzed and improved pipeline behavior by tracing source feeds, SQL logic, PySpark transformations, failed outputs, missing data, latency symptoms, and downstream reporting discrepancies.
Supported workflow repeatability through operational runbooks, dependency notes, validation checkpoints, scheduled processing concepts, and Airflow-style orchestration awareness.

Implemented data quality and reconciliation practices across BMC TrueSight/TSCO, CA Wily/APM, AppDynamics, Oracle, and AWS-backed reporting layers to improve completeness, consistency, and correctness of pipeline outputs.
Optimized SQL queries, Oracle schemas, Redshift-backed workloads, indexes, views, partitioning patterns, and reporting data models for performance, maintainability, and cost-aware processing.

Partnered with infrastructure, analytics, application, engineering, and business teams to translate ambiguous data questions into reliable datasets, dashboards, documentation, and operational recommendations.
